casa_vln_bridge_audit.note: VLN backoff remains an action label and executable backoff_walk skill, but CASA threshold lookup uses walk.

rules.backoff: backoff highest; turns medium; forward low.
rules.forward: short_forward highest unless repeatedly rejected; turns medium; backoff low-to-medium for recovery; stop lowest.
rules.stop: stop requires visual stop cue in policy; DMPS last-resort stop remains non-success stop.
rules.turn_left: left turns highest; backoff+turn_left medium-high; opposite turn penalized unless repeated rejects.
rules.turn_right: right turns highest; backoff+turn_right medium-high; opposite turn penalized unless repeated rejects.

policy_internal_guard_vs_casa_replan_aud.note: Policy internal guards are logged separately from CASA replan/reject interventions.

visual_free_space_audit.fallback: If image read fails, score is unavailable and a conservative fixed proxy is used.
